page.overview:
Who is Dash Justice?

Dash Justice, often simply called Dash, is an Alpha Team minifigure released physically in 2001 after debuting in 5714 LEGO Alpha Team in 2000.

In the video game and in the 2001 sets, Dash Justice wears an all-black jumpsuit which includes: several pockets, several lasers, the Alpha Team globe insignia, and a distinct button-up collar. His belt was blank, and his legs included pockets and two textured pads. His hair is an earth orange Mini Wig, Crewcut, with the physical piece being based directly upon the nonphysical hairpiece in the video game. Dash is the only Alpha Team agent to lack a colored right sleeve.

In the Mission Deep Sea subtheme, Dash wears nearly exact same jumpsuit, but in earth blue and with a different leg print. He has the standard "double-bar" colour scheme, with a triangular pattern running down the sides. He often wears a dark grey Oxygenbottle With Tube and Mini Crash Helmet with a transparent blue visor: the visor is typically a Divers Mask, but it is a Mini Visor 2 in 4789 AT Aquatic Mech. His face was slightly changed, giving him grey eyes and a cleft chin.

In the Mission Deep Freeze subtheme, Dash wears sunglasses and a completely different outfit. His right sleeve is now bright blue (Charge's previous colour), and his shirt pattern is simpler, showing only a newer, triangular insignia, and several silver lines on the sides of the torso. He wears a silver belt, and several silver lines run down his pant legs. Due to earth orange being retired in 2004, his hair colour has been updated to reddish brown. In several nonphysical sources (such as the Mission Deep Freeze homepage, the Red Lens online games, and the Brick Street Journal), Dash retains his original face design.
